title: Efficiently Aligning Draft Models via Parameter- and Data-Efficient Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2603.09527v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference but suffers from performance degradation when target models are fine-tuned for specific domains. A naive solution is to retrain draft models for every target model, which is costly and inefficient. To address this, we introduce a practical parameter- and data-efficient framework named Efficient Draft Adaptation, abbreviated as EDA, for efficiently adapting draft models. EDA introduces three innovations: (1) a decoupled architecture that utilizes shared and private components to model the shared and target-specific output distributions separately, enabling parameter-efficient adaptation by updating only the lightweight private component; (2) a data regeneration strategy that utilizes the fine-tuned target model to regenerate training data, thereby improving the alignment between training and speculative decoding, leading to higher average acceptance length; (3) a sample selection me

translated_title: 基于参数与数据高效适配的草稿模型高效对齐方法
translated_abstract: 推测解码可以加速大语言模型的推理，但当目标模型针对特定领域进行微调后，其性能会出现下降。一种直接的做法是为每个目标模型重新训练草稿模型，但这成本高昂且效率低下。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种实用的参数与数据高效框架，称为“高效草稿适配”，简称 EDA，用于高效地适配草稿模型。EDA 引入了三项创新：（1）解耦架构，利用共享组件和私有组件分别建模共享的输出分布与目标特定的输出分布，只需更新轻量级的私有组件即可实现参数高效的适配；（2）数据再生策略，利用微调后的目标模型重新生成训练数据，从而提升训练与推测解码之间的对齐程度，带来更高的平均接受长度；（3）样本选择机制（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出参数与数据高效的草稿模型适配框架 EDA，通过解耦架构、数据再生策略和样本选择机制三项创新，高效地将草稿模型对齐到微调后的目标模型，从而提升推测解码的加速效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EDA, a parameter- and data-efficient framework that aligns draft models to fine-tuned target models through a decoupled architecture, a data regeneration strategy, and a sample selection mechanism, thereby improving speculative decoding performance.
